It records source, target, open, and compactified retained square families as preserved by quotient.
The Borel-Moore chain functor is separated in certificates/hybrid/quotient_after_correspondence_bm_chain_functor.
The theta_mu operation-comparison maps are separated in certificates/hybrid/quotient_after_correspondence_theta_mu_comparison.
The theta_mu associativity compatibility row is separated in certificates/hybrid/quotient_after_correspondence_theta_mu_associativity.
The HN transition compatibility of Q_E_R is separated in certificates/hybrid/quotient_after_correspondence_hn_transition_compatibility.
It does not prove compact-support pushforward base change, coefficient pullback for vanishing cycles, the projection formula, or aggregate population.
